shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin plunged below $65K due to record US spot ETF outflows.
Escalating Middle East tensions drive broad "risk-off" sentiment in markets.
Eurozone inflation surge and US Treasury sanctions on Iranian crypto exchanges.
Fear & Greed Index plummeted to 11, indicating "extreme fear" in the market.
Some altcoins like WLD, ENA, and privacy tokens show gains despite downturn.
